observations: White gaming console with a disc drive slot, wrapped in clear plastic film.
One white and black wireless controller with blue lights active on the touch pad area.
Rear view shows HDMI, LAN, two USB-A ports, and a power socket.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI JAYCYPHER GAMES' on all images.
The console is the original larger ('fat') design.

claims.evidence: The physical design in photo 0 and photo 2 matches the original Sony PlayStation 5 disc model.
The plastic wrapping obscures the surface, making it impossible to check for scratches or scuffs.
There are no photos showing the console connected to a screen or functioning.

risks.risk: Internal hardware failure (e.g., Blue Light of Death)
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the PlayStation home screen on a TV.

risks.risk: Console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN)
risks.proof: A photo of the console successfully logged into the PlayStation Store.

risks.risk: Disc drive may be unable to read discs
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game icon appearing on the dashboard.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive

risks.risk: Controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen on a TV.
Photo of the 'About' screen in system settings showing the model and storage.
Video of a disc being inserted and recognized by the system.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PlayStation 5 Fat (Disc Edition). While functionality is unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-working unit until proof of life is provided.
